title: Vril Society channels anti-gravity technology

tellings.quote: There are also claims about the Vril Society, a group said to have channeled anti-gravity technology and psychic powers from an ancient subterranean race.
So there are these claims that there was a group of mediums I think mostly women who were engaging in telepathic communication with basically a group of supermen.
tellings.difference: Says the mediums were mostly women in telepathic contact with 'supermen' and doesn't mention anti-gravity technology or a subterranean race.
tellings.link_reason: Vril Society mediums receiving knowledge by channeling or telepathy from a superior race, the same claim as the Vril channeling story.

as_told.title: Vril mediums in telepathic contact with supermen

plain: In Germany, sometime between the 1920s and the 1940s, a group called the Vril Society is said to have received anti-gravity technology and psychic powers from an ancient race living underground, passed on through mediums. Jesse Michels brings up these claims himself and names no source. The researcher Jason Jorjani tells it a little differently on the show: in his version the group was a circle of mediums, "mostly women" he thinks, who were "engaging in telepathic communication with basically a group of supermen." Jorjani mentions neither the underground race nor the anti-gravity machines, and he names no source either. If any of it were true, some of the strange technology claims tied to Germany in that period would have started in séance rooms, not laboratories.
